name: Play Pause Button
description: Pill button that toggles between Play and Pause labels while its icon morphs between a play triangle and pause bars and a radial gradient wipes between two colors.
contents: Single pill button with morphing play/pause icon and animated Play/Pause label
behavior: Click toggles the label, icon morph and background color wipe
Starts in the Play state; the first click switches to the Pause state
Hover lifts the button slightly and press pushes it down
editableByProps: Play and pause colors, label color, icon color, font size

needsCodeEdit.where: the <i> letter elements inside the label div

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Renders nothing until mounted on the client
